title: polygala forojulensis subsp. carniolica
intro: Polygala forojulensis subsp. carniolica, commonly known as Alpine Polygala, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the milkwort family (Polygalaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Polygala include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. While more research is needed to fully understand its effects, Alpine Polygala has been traditionally used to support respiratory and cardiovascular health.
